3.5" HDD Rack / Caddy / Holder (6 drives)

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1155098-3-5-hdd-rack-caddy-holder-6-drives#profileId-1189884

Attach the baseplate using simple 2-sided tape. The weight of the drives will keep it secure during normal use.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: PLA
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 6
- Infill: 25%
- Filament: PLA (#0ACC38)
